celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿وَالنَّجْمِ﴾ the Pleiades, ﴿إِذَا هَوَى﴾ when it set,

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ﴾ Muhammad, upon him be blessing and peace, from the path of guidance, ﴿وَمَا غَوَى﴾ he has not been involved in error, which is ignorance arising from a corrupt belief;

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿وَمَا يَنْطِقُ﴾ in what he brings you ﴿عَنِ الْهَوَى﴾ from the desire of his own self;

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿إِنْ﴾ (meaning: not) ﴿هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْيٌ يُوحَى﴾ to him.

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿ذُو مِرَّةٍ﴾ of strength and power, or of fine appearance, that is, Gabriel, peace be upon him; ﴿فَاسْتَوَى﴾ he settled,

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَهُوَ بِالْأُفُقِ الْأَعْلَى﴾ the horizon of the sun, that is, at its rising place, in his form in which he was created. The Prophet ﷺ saw him while he was at Ḥirāʾ; he had blocked the horizon as far as the west, and he fell down in a swoon. He had asked him to show himself in the form in which he was created, so he made an appointment with him at Ḥirāʾ; then Gabriel came down to him in the form of human beings.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿ثُمَّ دَنَا﴾ he drew near to him, ﴿فَتَدَلَّى﴾ he came even nearer,

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿فَكَانَ﴾ from him ﴿قَابَ﴾ the measure of ﴿قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَى﴾ than that, until he recovered and his fright subsided.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿فَأَوْحَى﴾ He, Exalted is He, ﴿إِلَى عَبْدِهِ﴾ Gabriel, ﴿مَا أَوْحَى﴾ Gabriel to the Prophet ﷺ; and the content of the revelation is not mentioned, to magnify its importance.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿مَا كَذَبَ﴾ with the light and the doubled [dhāl]: did not deny ﴿الْفُؤَادُ﴾ the heart of the Prophet ﴿مَا رَأَى﴾ with his eyes, of the form of Gabriel.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿أَفَتُمَارُونَهُ﴾ do you dispute with him and try to overcome him ﴿عَلَى مَا يَرَى﴾? An address to the idolaters who denied the Prophet's ﷺ seeing Gabriel.

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ﴾ in his form ﴿نَزْلَةً﴾ one time ﴿أُخْرَى﴾

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿عِنْدَ سِدْرَةِ الْمُنْتَهَى﴾ when he was taken on the Night Journey through the heavens; it is a lote tree to the right of the Throne, beyond which none of the angels or others passes.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿عِنْدَهَا جَنَّةُ الْمَأْوَى﴾ to which the angels and the spirits of the martyrs and the God-fearing resort.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ when ﴿يَغْشَى السِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَى﴾ of birds and other things; and إِذْ is governed (maʿmūla) by رَآهُ.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿مَا زَاغَ الْبَصَرُ﴾ of the Prophet ﷺ ﴿وَمَا طَغَى﴾ that is, his sight did not swerve from what it was meant to see, nor go beyond it, that night.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿لَقَدْ رَأَى﴾ in it ﴿مِنْ آيَاتِ رَبِّهِ الْكُبْرَى﴾ that is, the great ones, that is, some of them: he saw, of the wonders of the unseen dominion, a green cushion (rafraf) that blocked the horizon of the sky, and Gabriel having six hundred wings.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتُمُ اللَّاتَ وَالْعُزَّى﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here; the discussion follows in the next entry.]

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَمَنَاةَ الثَّالِثَةَ﴾ to the two before it, ﴿الْأُخْرَى﴾ an adjective of disparagement for the third. They are idols of stone that the idolaters used to worship, claiming that they would intercede for them with Allah. The first mafʿūl (object) of أَرَأَيْتُمُ is اللَّاتَ and what is conjoined to it, and the second is omitted. The meaning is: tell me, do these idols have power over anything at all, so that you worship them instead of Allah, who has power over what was mentioned before? And since they also claimed that the angels are the daughters of Allah, despite their dislike of daughters, there was revealed:

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿أَلَكُمُ الذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ الْأُنْثَى﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَى﴾ unjust; from ضَازَهُ يَضِيزُهُ, when he wronged him and was unjust to him.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿إِنْ هِيَ﴾ that is, the things mentioned are not ﴿إِلَّا أَسْمَاءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَا﴾ that is, with which you have named, ﴿أَنْتُمْ وَآبَاؤُكُمْ﴾ idols that you worship; ﴿مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ بِهَا﴾ that is, for worshipping them, ﴿مِنْ سُلْطَانٍ﴾ any argument or proof. ﴿إِنْ﴾ (meaning: not) ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾ in worshipping them ﴿إِلَّا الظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى الْأَنْفُسُ﴾ of what Satan has made fair-seeming to them, namely that they will intercede for them with Allah the Exalted; ﴿وَلَقَدْ جَاءَهُمْ مِنْ رَبِّهِمُ الْهُدَى﴾ on the tongue of the Prophet ﷺ, with decisive proof, yet they did not turn back from what they were upon.

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿أَمْ لِلْإِنْسَانِ﴾ that is, for every human being among them, ﴿مَا تَمَنَّى﴾ namely that the idols will intercede for them? The matter is not so.

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿فَلِلَّهِ الْآخِرَةُ وَالْأُولَى﴾ that is, this world; so nothing happens in either of them except what He, Exalted is He, wills.

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿وَكَمْ مِنْ مَلَكٍ﴾ that is, and many of the angels ﴿فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ﴾ — and how honoured they are with Allah — ﴿لَا تُغْنِي شَفَاعَتُهُمْ شَيْئًا إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ أَنْ يَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ﴾ to them in it ﴿لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ﴾ of His servants ﴿وَيَرْضَى﴾ with him, because of His words {وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ارْتَضَى}; and it is known that it does not come from them except after permission for it: {مَنْ ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِ}.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿إِنَّ الَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِالْآخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ الْمَلَائِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ الْأُنْثَى﴾ in that they said: they are the daughters of Allah.

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿وَمَا لَهُمْ بِهِ﴾ in this saying ﴿مِنْ عِلْمٍ إِنْ﴾ (meaning: not) ﴿يَتَّبِعُونَ﴾ in it ﴿إِلَّا الظَّنَّ﴾ which they have imagined; ﴿وَإِنَّ الظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِي مِنَ الْحَقِّ شَيْئًا﴾ that is, in place of knowledge, in matters where knowledge is what is required.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْ مَنْ تَوَلَّى عَنْ ذِكْرِنَا﴾ that is, the Quran, ﴿وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا الْحَيَاةَ الدُّنْيَا﴾ — and this was before the command to fight (jihād).

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ that is, seeking this world, ﴿مَبْلَغُهُمْ مِنَ الْعِلْمِ﴾ that is, the limit of their knowledge: that they preferred this world to the Hereafter. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنْ ضَلَّ عَنْ سَبِيلِهِ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ اهْتَدَى﴾ that is, He knows both and will recompense both.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ that is, He is the Owner of that, and among it are the one astray and the one rightly guided; He leads astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills; ﴿لِيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسَاؤُا بِمَا عَمِلُوا﴾ of idolatry and other things, ﴿وَيَجْزِيَ الَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا﴾ by affirming His oneness and other acts of obedience, ﴿بِالْحُسْنَى﴾ that is, Paradise. And He described the doers of good with His words:

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَائِرَ الْإِثْمِ وَالْفَوَاحِشَ إِلَّا اللَّمَمَ﴾ it is the minor sins, such as the glance, the kiss and the touch; so it is a disconnected exception (istithnāʾ munqaṭiʿ), and the meaning is: but the minor sins are forgiven through avoiding the major ones. ﴿إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَاسِعُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ﴾ through that and through accepting repentance. And concerning those who used to say "our prayer, our fasting, our pilgrimage" there was revealed: ﴿هُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾ (meaning: knowing) ﴿بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنْشَأَكُمْ مِنَ الْأَرْضِ﴾ that is, He created your father Adam from dust, ﴿وَإِذْ أَنْتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ﴾ plural of جَنِينٍ (foetus), ﴿فِي بُطُونِ أُمَّهَاتِكُمْ فَلَا تُزَكُّوا أَنْفُسَكُمْ﴾ do not praise yourselves, that is, by way of self-admiration; but by way of acknowledging the blessing it is good. ﴿هُوَ أَعْلَمُ﴾ that is, knowing ﴿بِمَنِ اتَّقَى﴾

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿أَفَرَأَيْتَ الَّذِي تَوَلَّى﴾ from faith, that is, apostatised when he was reproached for it and said "I feared Allah's punishment"; so the one who reproached him guaranteed to bear Allah's punishment for him if he returned to his idolatry, and to give him such-and-such of his wealth; so he returned,

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿وَأَعْطَى قَلِيلًا﴾ of the wealth named ﴿وَأَكْدَى﴾ withheld the rest; taken from الْكُدْيَةِ, which is hard ground like rock that stops the well-digger from digging when he reaches it.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿أَعِنْدَهُ عِلْمُ الْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَى﴾ does he know, as part of it, that another will bear the punishment of the Hereafter for him? No. He was al-Walīd ibn Mughīra, or someone else. The clause أَعِنْدَهُ is the second mafʿūl (object) of رَأَيْتَ in the sense of "tell me".

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿أَمْ﴾ (meaning: rather) ﴿لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِي صُحُفِ مُوسَى﴾ the books of the Torah, or scrolls before it,

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿وَ﴾ the scrolls of ﴿إِبْرَاهِيمَ الَّذِي وَفَّى﴾ fulfilled what he was commanded, as in {وَإِذِ ابْتَلَى إِبْرَاهِيمَ رَبُّهُ بِكَلِمَاتٍ فَأَتَمَّهُنَّ}; and the explanation of مَا [is]:

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَى﴾ etc. And أَنْ is lightened from the heavy form (mukhaffafa min al-thaqīla), that is: that no soul bears the sin of another,

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿وَأَنْ﴾ (meaning: that it is so that) ﴿لَيْسَ لِلْإِنْسَانِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَى﴾ of good; so he has nothing of the good from another's striving,

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُ سَوْفَ يُرَى﴾ that is, will be seen in the Hereafter,

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿ثُمَّ يُجْزَاهُ الْجَزَاءَ الْأَوْفَى﴾ the most complete. One says جَزَيْتُهُ سَعْيَهُ and بِسَعْيِهِ (I recompensed him [for] his striving).

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ﴾ with fatḥa, as a conjunction [to what precedes]; and it has been read with kasra, as a resumptive clause; and likewise what comes after it. So on the second [reading] the content of the clauses is not [part of what is] in the scrolls. ﴿إِلَى رَبِّكَ الْمُنْتَهَى﴾ the return and the destination after death, and He will recompense them;

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ﴾ whom He wills: He made him glad, ﴿وَأَبْكَى﴾ whom He wills: He made him sad;

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَمَاتَ﴾ in this world ﴿وَأَحْيَا﴾ for the resurrection;

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ خَلَقَ الزَّوْجَيْنِ﴾ the two kinds, ﴿الذَّكَرَ وَالْأُنْثَى﴾

celaleyn:46-46.t: ﴿مِنْ نُطْفَةٍ﴾ semen ﴿إِذَا تُمْنَى﴾ when it is poured into the womb;

celaleyn:47-47.t: ﴿وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ النَّشَاءَةَ﴾ with the long and the short vowel [النَّشْأَةَ], ﴿الْأُخْرَى﴾ the other creation, for the resurrection, after the first creation;

celaleyn:48-48.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ أَغْنَى﴾ people, by sufficiency through wealth, ﴿وَأَقْنَى﴾ gave wealth that is kept as a possession;

celaleyn:49-49.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ هُوَ رَبُّ الشِّعْرَى﴾ it is a star behind Orion (al-Jawzāʾ), which used to be worshipped in the Jāhiliyya;

celaleyn:50-50.t: ﴿وَأَنَّهُ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا الْأُولَى﴾ — and in one reading with the assimilation of the tanwīn into the lām, giving it ḍamma, and without hamza — they are the people of ʿĀd, and the other ones are the people of Ṣāliḥ,

celaleyn:51-51.t: ﴿وَثَمُودَا﴾ with full declension (ṣarf) as the name of the ancestor, and as a diptote for the tribe [وَثَمُودَ]; it is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to عَادًا; ﴿فَمَا أَبْقَى﴾ any one of them,

celaleyn:52-52.t: ﴿وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِنْ قَبْلُ﴾ that is, before ʿĀd and Thamūd, We destroyed them; ﴿إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَى﴾ than ʿĀd and Thamūd, because of Noah's long stay among them — {فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًا} — and they, besides not believing in him, used to harm him and beat him;

celaleyn:53-53.t: ﴿وَالْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ﴾ which are the towns of the people of Lot, ﴿أَهْوَى﴾ He let them fall, after raising them to the sky, overturned onto the earth, by His commanding Gabriel to do that;

celaleyn:54-54.t: ﴿فَغَشَّاهَا﴾ of stones after that ﴿مَا غَشَّى﴾ — left vague to inspire terror; and in Hūd: {فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ}.

celaleyn:55-55.t: ﴿فَبِأَيِّ آلَاءِ رَبِّكَ﴾ His blessings that point to His oneness and His power ﴿تَتَمَارَى﴾ do you doubt, O human being, or deny?

celaleyn:56-56.t: ﴿هَذَا﴾ Muhammad ﴿نَذِيرٌ مِنَ النُّذُرِ الْأُولَى﴾ of their kind, that is, a messenger like the messengers before him, sent to you as they were sent to their peoples.

celaleyn:57-57.t: ﴿أَزِفَتِ الْآزِفَةُ﴾ the Resurrection has drawn near;

celaleyn:58-58.t: ﴿لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ﴾ any soul ﴿كَاشِفَةٌ﴾ that is, none reveals it and makes it manifest but He, as in His words {لَا يُجَلِّيهَا لِوَقْتِهَا إِلَّا هُوَ}.

celaleyn:59-59.t: ﴿أَفَمِنْ هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ﴾ that is, the Quran, ﴿تَعْجَبُونَ﴾ in denial,

celaleyn:60-60.t: ﴿وَتَضْحَكُونَ﴾ in mockery, ﴿وَلَا تَبْكُونَ﴾ on hearing its promise and its threat,

celaleyn:61-61.t: ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ سَامِدُونَ﴾ amusing yourselves, heedless of what is required of you?

celaleyn:62-62.t: ﴿فَاسْجُدُوا لِلَّهِ﴾ who created you ﴿وَاعْبُدُوا﴾ and do not prostrate to the idols nor worship them.
